# StemForge Feature Analysis & Integration
*Synthesizing BS-Roformer Stem Separation, UVR Cleanup, Polyphonic MIDI & RVC from tsondo's StemForge*

---

## 1. Key Capabilities Adopted into Nādabrahma

### A. SOTA Stem Separation (BS-Roformer & Demucs)
* 2-stem (vocal / instrumental), 4-stem (drums, bass, vocals, other), and 6-stem (adds guitar & piano) separation.
* Auto-splits full songs generated by YuE 2 or MiniMax into discrete, editable stems on the timeline.

### B. 3-Stage Vocal Enhancement Suite
* **Clean Up:** 8 UVR denoise and dereverb presets.
* **Tune:** CREPE pitch tracking + Praat PSOLA autotune with raga scale snapping.
* **Effects:** Dynamic de-essing and presence excitation.

### C. Polyphonic Audio-to-MIDI & Web MIDI Hardware Out
* **BasicPitch:** Converts polyphonic acoustic audio (Sitar, Guitar, Piano) into editable MIDI notes on the piano roll.
* **Web MIDI Hardware Out:** Streams extracted or sequenced MIDI straight to external physical hardware synths with clock sync, program change, and panic button.

### D. RVC Applio Voice Conversion Engine
* 14 built-in singer characters + HuggingFace voice model browser.
* Selectable F0 algorithms (RMVPE, Harvest, Crepe) for expressive vocal timbre transformation.
